passage: In a small-town school, Gautam Sir announced that the science lab would stay locked after three o'clock, even for students preparing the fair project. Twelve students went quiet. Irfan stood up. "Sir, I get why there is a rule, but I cannot see how it is fair for the fair teams. Can we talk about it?" Someone giggled nervously. Meena stared at her desk, and Ravi shook his head. Gautam Sir raised an eyebrow, then folded his arms. "Meet me after class. Bring your idea." Irfan sat down; his hands were cold, but his voice had stayed steady.

qa.q: After what time would the science lab stay locked?
qa.a: The science lab would stay locked after three o'clock.

qa.q: What did Irfan feel while standing up to speak?
qa.a: Irfan felt nervous, with cold hands, yet steady enough to speak; he was afraid of the reaction but wanted to be fair to the fair teams.
Irfan first accepted that a rule can have a reason and then asked to talk, which separated respect for the teacher from agreement with the order.

qa.q: How might Gautam Sir have felt on hearing Irfan?
qa.a: Gautam Sir may have been surprised, given the raised eyebrow and folded arms, but he was open enough to invite Irfan to meet after class with an idea.

grounding: A teenager says I understand the rule but do not think it is fair, and asks to discuss it, separating respect from agreement.

passage: In a Manchester school, Mr Kofi handed Chen a detention slip for arriving late. Chen looked at it, took a breath and said, "I understand there is a rule about lateness, but the bus was cancelled and I do not think detention is fair. Could we talk after class?" Two classmates behind exchanged glances. Priya smiled at her shoes. Mr Kofi's mouth tightened. "After class, then." At the end of the lesson Chen showed the bus notice on a phone. Mr Kofi read it, nodded slowly, and tore up the slip.

qa.q: What did Chen show Mr Kofi at the end of the lesson?
qa.a: Chen showed the bus notice on a phone.

qa.q: What was Mr Kofi feeling when his mouth tightened?
qa.a: Mr Kofi was probably irritated or challenged at being questioned in front of the class, though he still agreed to talk afterwards.

qa.q: What in Chen's wording kept the disagreement respectful?
qa.a: Chen began with "I understand there is a rule", gave a reason, and asked to talk after class instead of arguing in front of everyone.

qa.q: What might Priya be feeling while smiling at her shoes?
qa.a: Priya may feel nervous and quietly impressed, or relieved that someone said it out loud; looking at her shoes suggests not wanting to be seen reacting.

grounding: A teenager says I understand the rule, but I do not think this is fair, and asks to discuss it, separating respect from agreement.
